description: Calculates a Vedic birth chart with VedicDost's own software (sidereal, Lahiri ayanamsa, Parashari, whole-sign houses, Vimshottari dasha): Lagna, Moon sign, birth nakshatra and pada, Sun sign, the nine planets with sign and house, and the running Mahadasha/Antardasha. Values are calculated, not guessed. Use for "make my kundli", "what is my rashi / lagna / nakshatra". Works for any city in the world.

language.description: User language: hi, en, mr, gu, bn, ta, te or kn (default en). Text and links come in this language.

place.description: Birth place: an Indian city ("Satna") or "City, Country" anywhere ("London, United Kingdom")

time.description: Birth time HH:MM, 24-hour local clock time (optional; without it Lagna and houses are skipped)

timezone.description: Optional IANA zone (e.g. Asia/Kolkata); found from the place if left out

name: get_kundli
title: Vedic birth chart (kundli)
